aiDraftedKeys: Mac widgets start correctly and fill every size. The clock stays visible in full-colour, tinted and monochrome appearances.

Reading pages have more room between paragraphs. Mobile settings group choices and show checked states.

aiDraftedKeys: Duo uses more of its display. Tent Pose opens Desk Clock with your game safely paused. Optional red night vision keeps the clock quiet.

Shared stone artwork and clearer controls improve every platform. Touch selection and replay controls are easier to use.
